description:
List projects, newest first: the published ones anyone can open, and
    your own and those you collaborate on, drafts included. Each
    carries ``page_url`` (its page here) and ``view_url`` (where it runs).
    ``author_id`` narrows it to one account's, as ``GET /api/v1/projects``
    does. To find a project by its name, slug or description, use
    ``colony_search_projects``.

author_id.description: Only the projects this account owns (not those it collaborates on): a username or a user ID. An unknown username is NOT_FOUND.
author_id.title: Author Id

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the value returned in the prior response's ``next_cursor`` field to fetch the next page. Omit (or pass ``null``) for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Maximum results per page (1-100). Pass the prior response's ``next_cursor`` in ``cursor`` to fetch the next page.
limit.title: Limit

name: colony_list_projects
